create_layerscale_module: create a LayerScale module with a given dimension and initial gamma values
create_layerscale_inplace: create a LayerScale module that performs in-place multiplication on input tensors
reset_layerscale_parameters: reset the LayerScale gamma parameters to their initial constant values
forward_layerscale_tensor: apply LayerScale forward pass to scale a tensor by learnable gamma weights
build_layerscale_for_transformer: build a LayerScale layer to scale transformer block outputs with small init values
